translations.answer: No. The maintainer only states that the JointModelComposite (Translation + SphericalZYX) is not fully supported and suggests using JointModelFreeFlyer; the original author has not returned the results of the replacement, and subsequent fixed-base joint anomalies were not addressed. Therefore, FreeFlyer is the maintainer's suggested direction, and it is not a verified universal fix.
translations.applicability: Original suggestion applies to Translation + SphericalZYX JointModelComposite; subsequent fixed-base joint anomalies are not within the verified scope of the original suggestion.
translations.credibility.rationale: No verified reproduction records have been formed.
translations.details.attempts.0: The maintainer suggests using JointModelFreeFlyer; the original author provides a minimal reproduction using two rotational joints; another user provides an alternative Jacobian function using CasADi (J, q) @ qdot.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Identify if the root joint model is not fully supported by JointModelComposite; compare Jdot and Jdot*qdot using minimal models, analytical expectations, or automatic differentiation.
translations.details.environments.0: Original model uses JointModelComposite (Translation + SphericalZYX) with LOCAL_WORLD_ALIGNED; subsequent minimal reproduction uses two rotational joints; the 2026 comment uses the Pinocchio CasADi interface, but the specific version is not stated.
translations.details.limits.0: Cannot consider the closed state as a resolved issue; cannot treat unverified CasADi code as equivalent to all reference systems used by Pinocchio.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Issue was closed on 2024-12-19, but no original author confirmed the FreeFlyer solution; the CasADi approach in 2026 has not been thread-retested or confirmed by the maintainer.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: When getFrameJacobianTimeVariation*qdot is not equal to getFrameAcceleration's dJdq, what does each of the Composite Joint, FreeFlyer, and direct automatic differentiation paths prove?
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: The maintainer only explicitly states that JointModelComposite might be the root cause and is not fully supported; the cause of the subsequent fixed-base minimal reproduction is not answered.
translations.details.symptoms.0: In the original model, two different dJdq results are reported; after switching to a minimal reproduction with two rotational joints, the original author still reports a discrepancy between the computed dJ and the expected value.
translations.media_summaries.0: The original author's minimal reproduction includes screenshots, but this card only uses the text, code, and handwritten expected values, not the matrix values from the screenshots.
translations.source.locator: Issue #2519, with comments issuecomment-2554021580 and issuecomment-2555687851; the original author's subsequent minimal reproduction is issuecomment-2555915806.
translations.source.title: Two handling directions for dJdq/Jdot inconsistency in Pinocchio Composite Joint have not been verified by the original thread.
